services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Conveniently located on vibrant Las Olas Boulevard in the heart of Fort Lauderdale’s arts and entertainment district, the museum is a perfect setting for dinners, receptions, meetings, conferences, presentations and performances. Team-building art classes with professional art instructors may also be arranged for groups. NSU Art Museum is housed in a stunning modernist building designed by renowned architect Edward Larrabee Barnes. The museum’s exceptional exhibitions, permanent collections and dynamic programming make it a premier destination for the arts.
